content:
There's no restricted or trial version of Thunderbird for Android or K-9 Mail. They are free and open source.

If an email is just remaining in outbox and never sends after a period of time, it is usually because it has been marked as a permanent send failure. This happens for two reasons.

1. There was a temporary issue stopping the message sending. Poor network connection as example. The app retries sending the email 5 times, then marks it as a permanent failure and never tries again.

2. The email is larger than your provider allows to be sent. This is checked before sending. Emails too large are marked as permanent send failures.

A silent Android notification is presented in the notification shade when this happens. You can enable these to sound, vibrate or popup by changing the apps miscellaneous notification category.

You can try moving the email from Outbox to another folder (drafts), then send it again.
